name: Deerkill Day Camp
description_short: Family run day camp in Suffern since 1958 for children from Pre-K 3 to entering 10th grade, with instructional and free swim, athletics, arts and specialty activities, 9 to 4 on weekdays. Tuition covers door to door busing, a hot lunch cooked on site, trips for older campers and a weekend family pool club.

sessions.name: Full summer (8 weeks, no camp July 5)

notes: Tuition varies by grade and pick up area and includes transportation, lunch and snack, trips, towels, camp shirt and backpack, and the weekend pool club. Price range shown is the 8 week rate for Rockland and Orange families: $5,950 (Pre-K 3 days a week) to $8,750 (Upper Camp, entering 2nd to 9th). Other 8 week rates run up to $10,350 (Upper Camp from New York City). Campers may also enroll for 2, 4, 5, 6 or 7 weeks; Rockland and Orange Upper Camp 2 weeks is $3,550. Credit card payments after the deposit carry a 3% processing fee. Weekdays 9 to 4. No tipping of staff on camp grounds. Before and after care is not run by the camp; it works with local day care programs for pick up and drop off.
